g.text: A sorting algorithm that arranges elements by comparing them to each other
using a defined order relation (< or > for numbers, alphabetical order for
It relies entirely on comparison-based, rather than using additional
properties like counting occurrences (count sort), or distributing elements
Compare 5 and 2, since 2 is smaller, swap them [2, 5, 9]
This process follows a comparison-based approach
because we are only using comparisons
An example of a different sort...
